Shanghai Municipal Police.
Shanghai.

Sirs,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your
letter re suppression of abduction of children,
and in reply to you thereto, I have to inform
you that any of our ships before leaving the port
is always submitted to an examination by the
examiners of our Southern (Kin Lee Yuen) Wharf,
should any of our passengers be suspected as
being an abductor, the nearest police are always
informed and requested to take such necessary
steps as it may deem fit.

However, your suggestion is very much
appreciated and will be circulated for information
of all concerned.

Yeh Tai Poong,
Commissioner of the
Administrative Bureau

SHANGHAI. D. 2871.
" " 31.
November 10th, 1931.

The Deputy Commissioner (Crime),
Shanghai Municipal Police,
S.H. GHAI.

Dear Sir,

We have your letter of 5th instant regarding the
abduction of Chinese children from the Settlement for the
purpose of sale.

This practice is one which, by its nature, is only
known to and apparent to the Chinese themselves, and does not
come directly to our notice. It has however occupied the
attention of the Anti-Kidnapping Society for many years past,
and this Society has, for a like period, kept a close watch on
passengers embarking by steamers at out French Bund pontoons with
a view to detecting those concerned in this particular crime.
A number of arrests have been made, so we understand, in this
way.

In the circumstances we think you would achieve the
best results in this matter by getting into direct touch thereon
with the Anti-Kidnapping Society, or with the French Municipal
Police, under whose auspices, we presume, the Society works.

Any cases of abduction which may be brought to our
notice would of course be reported to the authorities concerned,
the French Municipal Police.

Yours faithfully,
Per pro BUTTERFIELD & SWIRE,

1931年11月10日。

副总监（刑事），
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

尊敬的先生，

收到贵方本月5日来信，提及从租界绑架中国儿童以图贩卖之事。

此种行径因其性质使然，仅为中国民众所知且显而易见，并不直接为我方所察觉。然而，反拐卖协会多年来一直关注此事，并在同等时期内，密切监视在法租界外滩浮码头登轮的乘客，以期发现涉及此特定犯罪的人员。据我们所知，已通过这种方式逮捕了多人。

鉴于上述情况，我方认为，若贵方能直接与反拐卖协会联系，或与法租界警务处联系（该协会推测在其主持下运作），将在这一事项上取得最佳成效。

任何引起我方注意的绑架案件，自然会向有关当局，即法租界警务处报告。

此致
敬礼，
谨代表 太古洋行，

Dated 9th November, 1931.
----

Kidnapping of children.

This Bureau has received the following letter from the Council:-
"As most of the kidnapped children leaving Shanghai
are sent to Southern ports for sale, the Bureau of Public
Safety is requested to give the necessary assistance and
to communicate with the Council so that officers may be
detailed to make enquiries whenever cases of kidnapping
of children occur so that the evil may be suppressed'.
Apart from instructing the parties concerned to act in conform-
ity with the Council's desire, this letter is written in reply.
The Council is asked to take note.
(Signed) Chen Fu (陳 復)
And Sealed - Bureau of Public Safety,
Provincial Capital of Kiangsu.

FOR THE NECESSARY ACTION DEPT.

POLICE
C. & S. B. STORY
Translation of despatch No. 434 to Council from
Bureau of Public Safety, Mush.
Dated 13th November, 1930

Kidnapping of children.

Receipt is acknowledged of the following communication from the
Council :-

"Statistics of crime in the Settlement show that the num-
ber of cases of kidnapping of children is on the increase.
Children are kidnapped from interior towns or outports. Although
many kidnappers, male and female, have been brought to justice,
it is not easy to completely suppress the traffic. Kidnapped
children are mostly sent away from Shanghai and sold at south-
ern ports. Letters have now been addressed to the several
shipping companies to request that measures be devised to -
assist the Council in this matter. The Bureau of Public Safety
is asked to afford the necessary facilities and, if cases of
traffic in children come to light, to notify the Council prompt-
ly so that officers may be despatched to make enquiries with the
object of uprooting the evil. As the request is made in the
interest of the public, it is believed that the Bureau will
gladly comply. Reply solicited."

Traffic in human beings is against the principles of humanity and is
condemned by society. In compliance with the Council's request, we
have instructed our police to exercise constant vigilance; the police
will arrest kidnappers and report.

(Chopped) Wo Puh (華 璞)
Commissioner.

Returned to Police Force
Th
14/11/31
Adieno.

C. & S. B. 卷宗
无锡公安局致工部局第434号公函译文。
日期 1930年11月13日

绑架儿童。

兹确认收到工部局如下来函：-

“租界犯罪统计显示，绑架儿童案件数量呈上升趋势。儿童多从内地城镇或通商口岸被绑架。尽管许多男女绑匪已被绳之以法，但完全遏制此类贩运并非易事。被拐儿童大多被带离上海，在南方港口出售。现已致函各轮船公司，请求制定措施以协助工部局处理此事。请公安局提供必要便利，若发现儿童贩运案件，请立即通知工部局，以便派遣人员进行调查，旨在根除此恶行。鉴于此请求乃出于公共利益，相信公安局将乐于配合。盼复。”

人口贩运违背人道主义原则，为社会所谴责。遵照工部局请求，我局已指令警察保持常备警惕；警察将逮捕绑匪并上报。

（盖章）华璞
局长。

退回警察部队
Th
1931年11月14日
Adieno.

have instructed our police to exercise constant vigilance; the police
will arrest kidnappers and report.

(Chopped) Wo Pun (華 璞)
Commissioner.

绑架儿童。

兹确认收到工部局如下来函：-

“租界犯罪统计显示，绑架儿童案件数量呈上升趋势。儿童多从内地城镇或通商口岸被绑架。尽管许多男女绑匪已被绳之以法，但完全遏制此类贩运并非易事。被拐儿童大多被带离上海，在南方港口出售。现已致函各轮船公司，请求制定措施以协助工部局处理此事。请公安局提供必要便利，若发现儿童贩运案件，请立即通知工部局，以便派遣人员进行调查，旨在根除此恶行。鉴于此请求乃出于公共利益，相信公安局将乐于配合。盼复。”

人口贩运违背人道主义原则，为社会所谴责。遵照工部局请求，我局已指令警察保持常备警惕；警察将逮捕绑匪并上报。

（盖章）华璞
局长。

Shanghai Municipal Council.
November 5, 1931.
POLICE FORCE.
(COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.)
P. O. Box No. 188

Sir,

I have to invite your attention to the following matter
and to request your kind co-operation in connection therewith.

Statistics of crime in the Settlement indicate that the
abduction of children for the purpose of sale is becoming more
prevalent despite the fact that many persons both male and
female are arrested and charged with the offence. Undoubtedly
most of the victims, those abducted locally as well as in the
interior are sent from Shanghai to southern coast ports for
disposal and it is felt that the co-operation of your department
is necessary to enable us to stop or at least successfully combat
this nefarious and obviously profitable business. I beg to
suggest therefore that information regarding cases wherein
children accompanied by adults give rise to suspicion be exchanged
by our respective departments, so that the necessary investigations
can be made into the case.

The local shipping companies have been requested to render
assistance on the lines suggested.

Any information you may be able, at any time, to furnish
will be much appreciated.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Sir,

I have the honour to invite your attention to the
following matter and to request your kind co-operation in
connection therewith.

Statistics of crime in this Settlement indicate that
the abduction of children for the purpose of sale is
becoming more prevalent despite the fact that many persons
are arrested and charged with the offence. A good
percentage of the victims are undoubtedly shipped from
Shanghai to southern ports for disposal. In view of this
fact I shall be grateful for any information you may be
able to furnish that would help us to curb the activities
of the persons engaged in this business.

The local shipping companies and Police Forces both
in southern ports and in the immediate interior have also
been requested to assist.

Thanking you for your attention to this matter.

先生：

荣幸地提请注意以下事项，并恳请就此给予合作。

本租界的犯罪统计表明，尽管许多人因此罪行被捕并被起诉，但以贩卖为目的的绑架儿童现象却日益普遍。毫无疑问，相当比例的受害者是从上海运往南部港口进行处理的。鉴于这一事实，若阁下能提供有助于我们遏制从事此勾当人员活动的信息，本人将不胜感激。

已请求本地轮船公司以及南部港口和邻近内地的警察部队提供协助。

感谢阁下对此事的关注。

荣幸地呈上，

先生，

您的恭顺仆人，

副总监（刑事）。

致 警察总部刑事情报处处长，
香港。

November 3, 31.

Gentlemen,

I have to invite your attention to the following matter
and to request your kind co-operation in connection therewith.

Statistics of crime in the Settlement indicate that the
abduction of children for the purpose of sale is becoming more
prevalent, despite the fact that many persons both male and
female are arrested and charged with the offence. Abductions
take place inside the Settlement and in cities and villages in
the interior. Most of the victims are sent from Shanghai to
southern coast ports for disposal and in view of this it is
felt that the co-operation of shipping companies is necessary in
order to stop or at least successfully combat this nefarious
business. I shall esteem it a favour, therefore, if you will
kindly issue the necessary instructions to your staff to notify
without delay, the nearest Police Station or Police Headquarters
of any cases coming to their notice wherein children are being
conveyed on steamers under suspicious circumstances. All such
reports will receive prompt and careful attention.

Any information you may be able, at any time, to impart
will be much appreciated.

诸位先生：

提请注意以下事项，并恳请就此给予合作。

租界内的犯罪统计表明，尽管已有许多男女因该罪行被捕并被起诉，但以贩卖为目的的绑架儿童现象却日益普遍。绑架发生在租界内以及内地的城镇乡村。大多数受害者从上海运往南部沿海港口进行处理，鉴于此，认为有必要得到轮船公司的合作，以制止或至少成功打击这一邪恶勾当。因此，若阁下能向员工发布必要指令，一旦发现有任何儿童在可疑情况下由轮船运送的情况，立即通知最近的警察局或警察总部，本人将视为一种恩惠。所有此类报告都将得到迅速且仔细的关注。

随时感谢阁下所能提供的任何信息。
